<!doctype html>
<html lang="ko">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
  <title>Vibe2</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="styles.css">
  <script src="scripts.js"></script>
</head>
<body>
  <main id="game"></main>
  <script>
    // Initialize game with preserved state and progression
    const game = {
      // Preserved state and progression data
      saveState: {
        player: {
          health: 100,
          energy: 50,
          position: { x: 0, y: 0 },
          inventory: []
        },
        enemies: [
          { id: 1, type: 'slime', health: 10, damage: 5 },
          { id: 2, type: 'pirate', health: 20, damage: 10 }
        ],
        progress: {
          level: 1,
          experience: 50,
          currency: { gold: 100, silver: 50 }
        }
      },
      // Game logic and progression system
      gameLoop: function() {
        // Game logic and progression system
      },
      // UI and input system
      ui: {
        healthBar: document.getElementById('health-bar'),
        inventory: document.getElementById('inventory'),
        statusMessage: document.getElementById('status-message')
      }
    };

    // Initialize game with preserved state and progression
    game.init();

    // Handle player input and game progression
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
      if (e.code === 'Space') {
        game.gameLoop();
      }
    });

    // Handle UI updates and game progression
    game.ui.healthBar.addEventListener('click', function() {
      game.saveState.player.health += 10;
    });

    // Handle enemy interactions and progression
    game.saveState.enemies.forEach(enemy => {
      enemy.health -= game.saveState.player.damage;
      if (enemy.health <= 0) {
        game.saveState.progress.experience += 10;
        game.saveState.currency.gold += 5;
      }
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>
